target_customer: Teams that manage servers and workstations across clouds, plus academic institutions and cloud providers
problem: SSH needs keys, static IPs and open ports. Teclada gives browser based shell access with no network configuration, shared terminals, role based access and command logging.
business_model: SaaS subscription with a free personal tier, Starter at 100 dollars a month and Pro at 500 dollars a month

founders.name: David Fiala
education: PhD (institution not stated on YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he led security for Google Health and several Google wide security initiatives, and his PhD relates to supercomputing resilience and security.

technical_complexity.rationale: A relay that connects browsers to servers without open ports, with auditing and approvals, is standard networking and security engineering for a solo technical founder.

defensibility.rationale: Open source browser terminals and large access vendors already offered similar functions, so differentiation rested on ease of setup.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Current comparison pages list Teleport, Warpgate and Cloudflare browser terminals as alternatives; no dated record of copying or acquisition of Teclada was found.

market_need_then: Not established with a dated source. Remote server access pain is long standing, but no 2022 or 2023 demand evidence was found for Teclada.

branding.domain_note: Uses teclada.com, an exact .com for the brand.

identity.logo: Wordmark with an orange accent, per the company site
identity.visual_style: Marketing site with demo call to action
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain technical, tagline Next Generation SSH

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found. The name resembles the Spanish word teclado for keyboard but no source says that was the intent.

outcome_analysis: Teclada is a very small team around a single founder with a security background at Google. The site still shows pricing tiers and a copyright notice for 2024, but no customers, rounds or outcome events were found. It looks like a stalled or quiet niche tool in a space with larger access vendors, and the real status is unknown.
notes: Funding unverified: one aggregator snippet reports a 500K pre-seed in April 2023 with Y Combinator and Trousdale Ventures and possibly Unpopular Ventures; a single aggregator, so not recorded as a round. Directory lists the company as open source but a search found no evidence. Headcount about 2 per one aggregator. Searches for shutdown or pivot found nothing about Teclada. Competitor list is empty because only undated, current comparison pages were found. Audit fix: the $500K pre-seed (2023-04-05) is now recorded from VCBacked; another aggregator also lists Unpopular Ventures, which is not confirmed. It rests on databases only.
